issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to the helper that prepares a noisy |Y> state as make_y_state(...), but the template repository provides a function named create_y_state(...) (and its NotImplementedError message even references make_y_state). This naming mismatch means a student following the problem text will look for make_y_state in the starter code but find create_y_state instead, creating unnecessary confusion about which function to implement and increasing extraneous cognitive load.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by renaming the function in template_repository/msd.py from create_y_state to make_y_state (and update its docstring/NotImplementedError message accordingly). This preserves the intended API described in the problem text and matches the solution implementation.
